classes.name: MediaDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for media decoding on Android, managing media codec interactions, decoding thread, and callbacks.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Interface for clients to receive notifications and process output buffers, end of stream, format changes, and handle flushing.
